subject: Vulnerability evidence request: scan cadence, uptime and CVE remediation commitments
messages:
From: Claire Monroe <claire@solaris-audit.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit-portal@clearbridge.com
Date: 2026-08-27T16:12:00Z
Subject: Vulnerability evidence request: scan cadence and CVE closure commitments

Hi Mina,

We are kicking off ClearBridge's SOC2 gap review and the audit team has a short evidence ask around your vulnerability management program. Can you please provide the following by EOD next Friday (2026-09-03):

- Confirmation of your authenticated dynamic (DAST) and unauthenticated static (SAST) scan cadence for production services (nightly / weekly / monthly)
- Recent uptime/availability for the nightly scans across the last 30 days (CSV acceptable)
- A short attestation that the three open/high CVEs listed below are assigned, triaged, and have a committed remediation date (or compensating control)
  - CVE-2026-4857
  - CVE-2026-4911
  - CVE-2026-5014
- Any playbook or runbook you rely on for emergency hotpatch windows and rollback procedures

If you can attach a manifest of the nightly scan runs (timestamps + status) that would be ideal. Let me know if you need more time — auditors are flexible by a couple of days but prefer the one-week turnaround.

Thanks,
Claire Monroe
Senior Auditor, Solaris Audit Services
Attachments requested: none in initial request

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Monroe <claire@solaris-audit.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-28T09:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Vulnerability evidence request: scan cadence and CVE closure commitments

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask. Sending an initial package and proposed attestation schedule below; final attestation (signed) will be provided after engineering confirms the last-step deploy windows.

Quick answers up front:
- Nightly DAST (authenticated scans) across public-facing services: nightly (run window 02:00–03:30 UTC)
- SAST (codebase): weekly (scheduled on Sundays 03:00 UTC)
- Scan uptime: attached CSV ("scan-uptime-logs-aug-2026.csv") includes run timestamps, duration, and status for the last 30 days

Open CVE commitments (current internal target/fallback):
- CVE-2026-4857 — assigned to ENG/secure-runtime, patch queued for 2026-09-02; can expedite to 2026-08-31 if required (hotpatch window).
- CVE-2026-4911 — low-impact server dependency; mitigation via compensating control (WAF rule) in place; planned code fix 2026-09-08.
- CVE-2026-5014 — privilege escalation in a third-party dep; vendor patch expected 2026-09-05; temporary container-level constraint applied 2026-08-26.

Attachments (initial set):
- nightly-dast-manifest-20260827.csv (manifest of nightly runs)
- scan-uptime-logs-aug-2026.csv (30-day summary)
- playbook-nightly-scan-2026.md (runbook excerpt: scan schedule, alert routing, escalation)

Next steps: I am looping in Karthik for remediation SLA confirmation and Marissa for evidence packaging. We plan to produce a signed attestation PDF that lists the CVEs with closure or compensating control notes by 2026-09-03. If auditors need the expedited CVE-4857 fix date earlier than 2026-08-31, we can request a hotpatch slot tonight.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: nightly-dast-manifest-20260827.csv; scan-uptime-logs-aug-2026.csv; playbook-nightly-scan-2026.md

2) Confirm the vendor patch arrival date for CVE-2026-5014 and whether container-level constraints remain in place after vendor fix.

Notes:
- If we take the hotpatch tonight, Mina will update the attestation and send the signed PDF to the audit team immediately.

Cc: audit-portal@clearbridge.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-04T15:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Vulnerability evidence request: scan cadence and CVE remediation commitments — attestation attached

Claire — thanks for the patience. Per the internal checks below:

Summary (final):
- Nightly authenticated DAST: nightly (02:00–03:30 UTC) — evidence attached ("nightly-dast-manifest-20260827.csv").
- SAST cadence: weekly (Sundays 03:00 UTC) — runbook excerpt attached.
- Scan uptime (last 30 days): attached CSV ("scan-uptime-logs-aug-2026.csv"). Overall nightly scan success rate: 98.7%.

CVE disposition (final attestation):
- CVE-2026-4857 — patched in production during hotpatch window on 2026-08-31 at 23:45 UTC. Proof: deploy build ID bd3f7c and post-deploy scan (JIRA:SEC-4821).
- CVE-2026-4911 — mitigated with WAF rule and scheduled code fix 2026-09-08; compensating control in place since 2026-08-29.
- CVE-2026-5014 — vendor patch applied 2026-09-03; container constraint was removed after verification 2026-09-03 04:10 UTC.

Attached: CVE-closure-attestation-20260903.pdf (signed by security leadership), nightly-dast-manifest-20260827.csv, scan-uptime-logs-aug-2026.csv, playbook-nightly-scan-2026.md

If the auditors need any additional artefacts (build logs, signed roll-forward notes, or a notarized attestation), Marissa will follow up and drop them into the shared Drive link here: https://drive.redwood.ai/s/VM-Audit-2026 and reference JIRA SEC-4821.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CVE-closure-attestation-20260903.pdf (PDF, 32KB); nightly-dast-manifest-20260827.csv (CSV); scan-uptime-logs-aug-2026.csv (CSV); playbook-nightly-scan-2026.md (Markdown)
